semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in precision spray technology solutions that are critical for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Spraying Systems Europe B.V. provides high-precision spray nozzles and solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on enhancing production efficiency and product quality. With over 85 years of experience, they collaborate with clients to develop innovative spraying technologies for applications such as wafer coating, cleaning, and surface treatment.
capabilities: Coating and drying of wafers and solar panels
Cleaning and coating for transport systems
Wet processes for printed circuit boards and electronic components
Development of specialized nozzles for specific applications
